data.name: Nereid's Grace
data.description: When unarmored and unencumbered, a water dancer adds %1 to his Armor Class as a dodge bonus. If he is caught flat-footed or otherwise denied his Dexterity bonus, he also loses this bonus. He uses his Charisma score instead of his Wisdom score to determine the size of his ki pool and the DC and effects of monk class features.|min(CHA,MonkLVL)
